Full-body character concept sheet, strict front view, single character centered on a plain neutral grey background, soft studio light. Slim athletic young woman, confident half-smile, sharp eyeliner. Black sleeveless high-neck bodysuit with thin red accent lines and a front zip, wide black utility belt with a small side pouch.
